scripts.build: npm run generate && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.check: npm run generate && npm run check:metadata && npm run check:frontend && node scripts/check-engine.mjs && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts/*.mjs contracts/*.json examples/*.json package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .prettierrc.json src-tauri/*.json src-tauri/capabilities/*.json
scripts.check:frontend: tsc --noEmit && npm run check:boundaries && prettier --check src scripts/*.mjs contracts/*.json examples/*.json package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .prettierrc.json src-tauri/*.json src-tauri/capabilities/*.json
